name: Jimmy Choo
band_note: shoe house, banded on shoe entry $850 (women's price pass, 2026-10-22)
why: Luxury women's shoes, handbags and small accessories, plus men's shoes and bridal, made largely in Italy and designed in London.
origin: Founded in London in 1996 by Jimmy Choo and Tamara Yeardye (now Mellon).

ownership.owner: Capri Holdings Limited (NYSE: CPRI); Jimmy Choo is one of two reportable segments, about 17% of fiscal 2026 revenue

quote.q: A beautifully crafted shoe or bag isn't designed for one season; it's designed to become part of someone's life.

opview: “A beautifully crafted shoe or bag isn't designed for one season; it's designed to become part of someone's life.” — Sandra Choi, Creative Director, Signature Craftsmanship page, us.jimmychoo.com

facts_read.source: us.jimmychoo.com craftsmanship and history pages; SEC 10-K FY2026 (year ended 28 Mar 2026, filed 27 May 2026); vinted.com brand filter; therealreal.com; bcorporation.net and global-standard.org

Shoes.lp: Ixia 80 black nappa leather pumps (core pump entry)

price_read.sublines: Jimmy Choo own label only (the house sells nothing else)

doors.note: 35 = 31 returned (18 own-door + 13 outlet) + 1 counter (Jimmy Choo at Bloomingdale's, Chestnut Hill: not a row) + 3 held for ruling (Forum Shops at Caesars, Shoppes at the Palazzo, Americana Manhasset: locator type says Department but they are mall addresses). us_own_stores includes San Juan PR. 13 outlets = 11 typed Outlet + 2 with no type whose names say Outlet. Stockists NC. Outside the US this locator returns nothing (Canada, Mexico, France: none) or one counter (UK: Harvey Nichols Edinburgh), so abroad is NC, not NONE

craft_evidence.owned: YES: the Craftsmanship page says production largely takes place in Florence, Italy, "where the brand owns two factories"; the Capri 10-K says Capri owns two luxury footwear manufacturing facilities in
craft_evidence.makers: NONE (the factories are named by city only; no maker or workshop name on product pages)
craft_evidence.mills: NONE on product pages; one pump page says it was made using leather certified by a body I did not open
craft_evidence.madein: 100% of 26 sampled women's shoe and bag pages state a country: 25 Made in Italy, 1 Made in Vietnam (a shoe); 10-K says m
craft_evidence.heritage: dated and placed: bespoke shoes by Jimmy Choo in an East London studio from the 1980s; J. Choo Limited co-founded in 1996 by Jimmy Choo and Tamara Yeardye (now Mellon); first boutique on Motcomb Stree
craft_evidence.process: partial: a Craftsmanship page and "Stories from the atelier" describe designed in London, made in Florence, and hand work with modern methods, with no step-by-step process
craft_evidence.reasoning: Jimmy Choo says on its own site that it owns two factories in Florence, and 25 of 26 sampled product pages state Made in Italy, so the maker and the brand are close. It scores 4 not 5 because the owned factories do not cover the whole range (one sampled shoe is made in Vietnam, the 10-K lists other European and Asian makers), no factory or mill is named, and the 10-K is the only filing that says C
